display.label: DNS Zone
display.description: Azure DNS Zone for hosting public DNS domains and managing name resolution records

resource.key_description: The unique domain name for the Azure DNS Zone (e.g. example.com). Serves as the map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core DNS Zone domain name and resource group placement.

fields.label: Domain Name
fields.description: Name of the DNS Zone. Must be a valid domain name (e.g., example.com, sub.example.com). Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

validation.pattern_error: Must be a valid domain name (e.g., example.com) between 1 and 253 characters.

fields.label: Resource Group Name
fields.description: The name of the Resource Group in which to create the DNS Zone. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

validation.pattern_error: Resource Group name must be 1-90 characters (alphanumerics, underscores, parentheses, hyphens, periods) and cannot end in a period.

sections.label: SOA Record Settings
sections.description: Custom Start of Authority (SOA) record settings for the DNS Zone. If omitted, Azure defaults are used.

fields.label: SOA Record
fields.description: Customize the Start of Authority (SOA) record for the zone.

fields.label: Administrator Email
fields.description: The email contact for the SOA record, using a dot instead of @ (e.g. hostmaster.example.com).

fields.label: Authoritative Name Server
fields.description: The domain name of the authoritative name server for the SOA record. Leave empty to let Azure automatically configure.

fields.label: Expire Time (seconds)
fields.description: The time in seconds that a secondary name server will treat its zone data as valid before expiring (default: 2419200 = 28 days).

fields.label: Minimum TTL (seconds)
fields.description: The minimum Time To Live in seconds for negative caching (default: 300 = 5 minutes).

fields.label: Refresh Time (seconds)
fields.description: The interval in seconds before the zone should be refreshed (default: 3600 = 1 hour).

fields.label: Retry Time (seconds)
fields.description: The interval in seconds that should elapse before a failed refresh should be retried (default: 300 = 5 minutes).

fields.label: Serial Number
fields.description: The serial number for the SOA record (default: 1).

fields.label: SOA TTL (seconds)
fields.description: The Time To Live for the SOA record set in seconds (default: 3600 = 1 hour).

fields.label: SOA Record Tags
fields.description: A mapping of tags to assign to the SOA record set.

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: Resource tags for organization, governance, and billing.

fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Key-value pairs to tag the DNS Zone for organization, governance, and billing.
